presentationTimer.title: Presentation Timer
presentationTimer.description: Countdown timer for talks, meetings and classes — speaker mode, section timer, overtime count and shareable setup links

howto.title: How to Use
items: Pick a length from the presets or type the minutes
Split into sections like Intro / Main / Q&A to see time left per section
Start and pause with the button, by tapping the time, or with Space
Open speaker mode (F key) to show the time full screen
Adjust the current section by a minute with ↑↓ or the ±1 buttons

features.title: Key Features
items: Color stages: normal → yellow (wrap-up warning) → red (overtime, counting up)
Sound and vibration at the warning, section changes and the end
Keeps the screen awake while the timer runs
Accurate even if you switch tabs
Setup is saved in the URL, so a moderator can share it as a link

tips.title: Presentation Tips
items: Spend about 70–80% of the time on content and the rest on Q&A
Warn 2 minutes before the end for a 10-minute talk, 3 minutes for 20+
On a microphone, turn sound off and rely on vibration and color
Save the result card after rehearsals to compare against your target

whatIs.title: What is the Presentation Timer?
whatIs.description: A professional countdown timer optimized for presentations, lectures, and meetings. Features include color-changing visual warnings as time runs low, full-screen mode, and a last-minute alert. Works for solo presentation practice or as an MC tool to manage multiple speakers' time.

items.q: Can I keep the timer hidden from the audience?
items.a: Open speaker mode on a laptop or phone in front of you. The audience sees only your slides while you see the time left in large type.

items.q: What happens when time runs out?
items.a: The screen turns red and keeps counting overtime like +01:23. When you stop, it shows your result, e.g. '+1m 23s vs target'.
Yes. It chimes at the warning point, section changes and the end, and vibrates on phones. If sound would distract, turn it off and rely on vibration and color.

rehearsal.title: Rehearsal history & comparison
rehearsal.hint: Enable before starting, then mark each segment boundary yourself. Unvisited segments stay unmeasured. Save up to 20 runs in this browser; clearing site data removes them.
rehearsal.name: Rehearsal name
rehearsal.differentPlan: The selected plan is different, so only total times are compared.
rehearsal.storageFailed: Could not read or save history. Current measurements remain on screen. Check storage and browser settings.
rehearsal.full: Up to 20 runs can be saved. Download and delete an older run, then retry.
rehearsal.tooShort: Practice for at least one second before saving.
rehearsal.planLocked: The plan stays fixed while recording. Reset to change segment names and targets.
